sources.title: How to be IRL Chameleon 🌸🦎 MID + SUPPORT GUIDE [26.13]
[S16.19] Support Neeko, Burst, Poke, Utility, Tomato.

passive.name: Inherent Glamour
passive.text: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.text: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.text: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.text: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.text: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

damage.value: Neeko deals burst damage with AP builds.

archetype.value: Neeko is a mage who can play for burst, poke, or crowd control.

axis.value: Neeko can poke in lane, clear waves, and roam.

winCondition.value: Neeko wins through roams, reliable engages, and strong teamfight impact.

spikes.why: Neeko gets a small power spike from this item.
Neeko’s Pop Blossom gives her a powerful AoE engage that can win teamfights.

mistakes.value: Neeko loses her disguise by casting a damaging spell, so Neeko should not expect it to remain afterward.
